entities.name: CoaBC
observations: 410-aa query is 47.4% identical over 95.1% coverage to reviewed Mycobacterium CoaBC homologs (E-value 9.44e-101).
Likely bifunctional enzyme catalyzing phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligation and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation in coenzyme A biosynthesis.
Homolog annotations indicate FMN and Mg2+ cofactors; specific cofactors are inferred from homology, not measured for the query.
